factProposals.value: The help desk has three roles in use: the TxDOT user who reports, the support person who resolves, and a support lead who receives tickets when nobody is on duty.
The data model is created as the store of the workspace; AuditEntry was added because every Milestone 1 story requires its actions to be logged.
Every write is checked against the data model and appended to a SHA-256 hash chain; a changed or missing line is detected.

decisions.statement: The workspace runs in the browser with the store in localStorage, using synthetic people only.
decisions.rationale: No TxDOT system or account is available to this build, and the site is public on GitHub Pages.

decisions.statement: A record and its audit line are saved together or not at all.
decisions.rationale: An action that is not logged would break the Trust line.

decisions.statement: Reports can be submitted twice safely with an idempotency key.
decisions.rationale: A double click or a retry must not create a second ticket.

limitations.statement: The store is per browser: two people on two machines do not see each other's tickets until a shared backend replaces localStorage.
The help articles are sample content written for the demo, to be replaced by TxDOT's own; matching is by keywords.
The service levels used for the answer deadline are a proposal; the plan sets none.
